title.en: AI spending grows; efficiency changes who captures it
title.zh: AI 支出成長，效率改變獲利分配

summary.en: Constructive on realized infrastructure demand, with less conviction in spending extrapolations. Company revenue and serving efficiency point in different directions for revenue per task.
summary.zh: 看好已實現的基礎設施需求，但降低對支出線性外推的信心。公司營收與服務效率，對每項任務收入的含義並不相同。

methodology.zh: 本期僅引用具日期的公司揭露，不含模擬報價。季度資料保留原日期；事件與基準不是持續量測。分析判斷與公司宣稱分列。
methodology.en: This edition cites dated company disclosures, not modeled quotes. Quarterly facts retain their original dates; events and benchmarks are not continuous measurements. Analyst interpretations are separate from company claims.

notInvestmentAdvice.zh: 本快報不構成投資建議。
notInvestmentAdvice.en: This brief is not investment advice.
